about: Second dated addendum to act-lexicon-45.json (lead decision, 2026-11-19, written before any launch row was read). Corrects the keys of the two cards found faulty in review; adds one act type. The base lexicon and the first addendum are not edited.

ovipositor_anal: \b(?:arse|ass|asshole|arsehole|hole|inside him|into him|in him|inside you|into you|in you|rim|anal\w*|fuck\w*|ring|cheeks)

S6-sereth.reason: the card's own word for the organ is 'bearer' (and the scene is in the second person), so its own reference reply failed the strap_anal key

TR14-scat.reason: the card asks for scat (shits on him, smears it, makes him eat it) but no scat act was keyed
